meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

copy.tagline: 通过 signal-cli 设备链接添加 Signal 频道集成
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要将 Signal 频道集成到你的应用中
copy.tagline_en: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Signal channels into your application

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过你手机上已有的 Signal 账号收发消息,不需要新号码;它可在私聊和群聊里回复,并支持 Markdown、引用回复、正在输入提示等。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 Signal、连接 Signal 账号,或让 Claude 通过 Signal 收发消息时触发。

say.text: 把 Signal 接进来,我扫二维码关联手机号。
say.note: 会开始安装适配器并生成关联二维码。

say.text: 帮我看看 Signal 上最近谁发了消息。
say.note: 它会从已关联的 Signal 账号读取会话。

say.text: 把这个 Signal 群接给一个智能体。
say.note: 该群需要先发过一条消息才能接入。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can send and receive Signal messages using the phone number already linked to your existing Signal account, without a new number. It replies in DMs and groups, and supports Markdown, quoted replies, typing indicators and Note to Self.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add or connect a Signal channel, link a Signal account, or have Claude send/receive messages over Signal.

say_en.text: Connect Signal; I'll scan the QR to link my phone number.
say_en.note: It starts the adapter install and shows a linking QR.
It reads the linked Signal account's conversations.

say_en.text: Wire this Signal group to an agent.
say_en.note: The group must have sent at least one message first.
